---
name: review
description: Review architecture documents or source code for quality, security, and standards.
---

Inspect the target architecture document (`architecture.md`) or source files in `src/`.

Check for security vulnerabilities, missing input validation, error handling gaps, and adherence to project standards.

Categorize findings by severity (Critical, Major, Minor) with actionable recommendations.

Generate `code-review.md` and wait for human approval before making code changes.
